expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit maps to the pair-kernel observable; decoded terminal affinity labels unavailable.

failure_modes: If a short pair-shell edit were compiled, the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel term, so the intended 1.5-3.5 A shell response would not be produced and surrounding coordinates could be displaced without the hypothesized benefit.

A time-conditioned teacher/attention edit built on poorly fitted continuous curves (many sign changes, relative_node_RMSE up to ~0.995) could reverse sign within the observed support and degrade rather than improve the endpoint.
A teacher-contrast-based coordinate rule may not improve observed child score, since selection innovation anti-aligns with observed_child_score_gain (joint_diagnostics:2).
Any edit justified by turnover_residual_rate would conflate score reclassification and extant-parent weighting with a causal selection effect.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible coordinate signal is the short pair-distance shell (pair_kernel_1.5-3.5 positive in endpoint_effects:9-11 and branch_adjusted:86/87/240/241; pair_kernel_7.0 negative in endpoint_effects:13), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can be tied to that observable without treating a diagnostic feature as a force the formula does not contain. The remaining candidate levers are unsupported: decoded terminal affinity labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false; lineage_support records joint-head credit at terminal_score_time 0.99), so no final-affinity advantage can be predicted; continuous contrast curves mostly fail the curve_support fidelity rule with many sign changes (continuous:1/7/17), so a time-conditioned teacher/attention edit is not defensible; turnover residuals for local_cxx/local_cyy (turnover:14/17/47/134) are accounting diagnostics including reclassification and parent weighting, not causal selection effects; and joint_diagnostics:2 shows selection innovation anti-aligns with observed child score gain (joint_diagnostics:1/11/14), so a teacher-contrast-based coordinate rule may not improve observed child score. With affinity primary and no defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining the incumbent is the correct bounded choice; temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed.
